title: Muse Gadgets
summary: Muse Gadgets is a collection of AI-powered tools and applications from Muse.ai, a company specializing in AI-driven music and audio technology. Based on its Hacker News popularity with 209 points and 92 comments, it appears to offer innovative AI gadgets or utilities for creators.
